description: Create a REAL booking at one establishment of the Adaga network. WORKFLOW: (1) call network_search to get fresh availability and the exact price, (2) collect traveler full name and email, (3) call this tool, (4) give the human the payment instructions from the response — the booking is confirmed only after secure card payment; unpaid bookings expire automatically. Optional inputs: guests (number of guests), guest_phone (international format, e.g. +352661661438), special_requests (free text), breakfast (boolean), promo_code (string, validated by the establishment), extras (array of integer extra ids from the establishment offer). Fails with 409 if the room became unavailable.

breakfast.description: Add breakfast if the establishment offers it

extras.description: Extra ids (integers) from the establishment offer

promo_code.description: Promo code, validated by the establishment

name: network_book
